01 —ABOUT THE DESIGNER

No studio.
No funding.
No shortage of intent.

Every piece here was designed solo — concept, illustration direction, typography and garment layout — without a team, a brand behind it, or a budget. The work is built to sit next to anything already on a rack, and validated the only way that matters: strangers wanting to wear it.

Production Docket

Every tee starts as a character study, not a template — the print earns its size before it earns the shirt.

01
Character Study

Choosing a moment and expression that carries the character's arc, not just their face.

02
Render & Grade

Rebuilding the portrait's tone and contrast in Photoshop for print — manga panels don't survive a garment as-is.

03
Type & Lore

Pairing the art with typography and a short lore line that reads like packaging, not a caption.

04
Front/Back Layout

Mocking the full garment in Blender to check scale, placement and how front and back speak to each other.
